WITH type_avgs AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) as type_avg_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT type_avg_price
  FROM type_avgs
  WHERE type_avg_price > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) as kept_mean_value
  FROM above_overall
),
final_types AS (
  SELECT type_avg_price
  FROM above_overall
  WHERE type_avg_price > (SELECT kept_mean_value FROM kept_mean)
)
SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) as type_average_price,
       AVG(type_avg_price) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) as above_overall,
       AVG(type_avg_price) - (SELECT kept_mean_value FROM kept_mean) as above_kept_mean
FROM final_types
